name: title-pattern
description: As feature-request.json, but acme-co/web has a title_pattern and conventions in jotflow.toml. The agent's first title doesn't match, propose_issue refuses it with the pattern, and the agent proposes again with a title that does.

repos.description: The customer web app: dashboard, login, reports
repos.conventions:
Every issue needs an ## Acceptance checklist.
Use the enhancement label for new features, never for bugs.

repos.description: The public REST API and the billing service behind it

events.text: It would be great if the dashboard could export the current table as CSV. Finance asks for this every month.
Yes please, even just the visible columns would do.

arguments.title: Export the dashboard table as CSV
arguments.body:
## Problem
Finance needs the dashboard table every month, and there is no way to download it.

## Proposal
Export the current dashboard table as a CSV file. The visible columns alone would do.

## Suggested approach
Drafted by the agent from the discussion; adjust before starting.

1. Add an Export CSV action to the dashboard table.
2. Write the visible columns and rows, in their current order, to a CSV file.
3. Name the file after the dashboard so monthly exports are easy to tell apart.

## Acceptance
- [ ] The dashboard can export its current table as a CSV file
- [ ] The file holds the visible columns, in the order shown
- [ ] An empty table exports a file with just the header row

## Context
No related issue was found. Open question: should hidden columns be offered later?

issues.title: Password reset email arrives late
issues.body: Reset emails take up to an hour to arrive.

issues.title: Dashboard loads slowly with many widgets
issues.body: With more than twenty widgets the dashboard takes ten seconds to load.

issues.title: Keyboard shortcuts for the reports page
issues.body: Let people move between reports with the arrow keys.

issues.title: Rate limit headers missing on 429 responses
issues.body: Clients cannot tell when to retry.

issues.title: Webhook retries ignore the backoff setting
issues.body: Retries fire every second regardless of the configured backoff.
